name: Adults with a high-school credential
source: U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts, Monterey County, California; 2020–2024 ACS period
notes: QuickFacts reports 73.3% for the 2020–2024 period. Census QuickFacts was opened directly; a retry after enabling browser fallback still returned HTTP 403 in the browser, so no snapshot was saved. Local tier-1 searches did not expose a newer countywide attainment figure. The period begins in 2020, so this is the latest available multi-year ACS estimate rather than a single-year 2021+ observation.
